description: [Accra] Trotro and Shared Taxi Route Legs is a data set listed in Transport Data Commons (Transport Data Catalogue), a transport data catalogue, published or maintained by Transport for Cairo. Representative alignments for 224 public transport route legs (192 trotro and 32 shared taxi) in the Greater Accra Metropolitan Area, produced from GPS traces collected during onboard surveys and map-matched to the road network. A route leg is one direction of travel between a pair of terminals. Coverage: Ghana. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for Cairo. Its tags are Accra, Ghana, Public Transport. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEOJSON, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support road network, traffic and accessibility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tdc-portal.
